title: A Most Violent Year
description: In 1981 New York, a fuel supplier (Oscar Isaac) tries to adhere to his own moral compass amid the rampant violence, corruption and decay that threaten his family and his business.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E04 — Episode 4
Hal and John press forward with their investigation into Manhunter's true identity. The Guardians grow restless in their efforts to replace Hal.

title: Taken 2
description: Taken hostage with his wife in Istanbul, retired CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) enlists his daughter's (Maggie Grace) aid in helping him escape, then uses his particular set of skills to exact revenge on the kidnappers.

title: When You Clean a Stranger's Home
description: Abby, a first-generation high school student, describes what she and her mom have learned about people when cleaning their homes.

title: Stand Up & Shout: Songs From a Philly High School
description: Students at Philadelphia's Hill-Freedman World Academy work with local musicians to create an album of powerful, original songs that captures both the challenging times they're living in and the joy that music brings.

title: A Killer Story
description:
S01 E01 — Welcome to Topeka
When a double murder conviction is overturned with the help of two citizen sleuths, investigative journalist Joe Sexton digs into the case.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E01 — We Just Decided To
After a meltdown, Will McAvoy returns to work to find most of the staff are leaving his show; Will's new executive producer is also his ex-girlfriend; Will and his new staff face a challenge.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E02 — News Night 2.0
Mac begins to control the new incarnation of "News Night"; Jim takes the fall for Maggie's miscue; Charlie forbids Reese from secret meetings with Will.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E03 — The 112th Congress
Will apologizes on-air for past newscasts; Charlie is warned by management; Jim soothes Maggie during a panic attack; Will parades his dates in front of Mac.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E04 — I'll Try to Fix You
Will lands in the tabloids; Wade approaches Will with information; Don asks Maggie to set Jim up with her roommate; Will refuses to make a call on a breaking story.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E05 — Amen
The team learns about a protest in Wisconsin; Maggie, Jim and Don work hard to feature simultaneous uprisings; Neal tracks down an Egyptian insider.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E06 — Bullies
Will runs a controversial segment that causes him to receive death threats; Will suffers from insomnia; Sloan jeopardizes her career; Will handles an interview subject roughly.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E07 — 5/1
An anonymous source provides advanced details on an important story; the staff cuts its anniversary party short.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E08 — The Blackout Part I: Tragedy Porn
Will and Mac abandon principles when ratings plummet; Sloan is irked by her lack of screen time; Charlie discovers a whistleblower's identity.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E09 — The Blackout Part II: Mock Debate
The staff stages a mock debate; Mac has an epiphany; Lisa goes off-script during an interview; Neal goes undercover.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S01 E10 — The Greater Fool
Nina surprises Mac; Sloan considers a job offer; Neal smokes out a threat; Will, Mac and Charlie face off against Leona and Reese.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E01 — First Thing We Do, Let's Kill All the Lawyers
Will and the staff are questioned by a lawyer; an on-air remark gets Will pulled from Sept. 11 anniversary coverage; Jim volunteers to cover for a reporter on the Romney campaign; Neal investigates the beginnings of Occupy Wall Street.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E02 — The Genoa Tip
A tip on a story that will cripple the network begins to become more real; MacKenzie and Sloan continue to push Will; Don urges Will to advocate for Troy Davis; Maggie gets an assignment that she has been begging for; Neal is arrested on Wall Street.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E03 — Willie Pete
Will tells Nina Howard the truth; a new witness to the Genoa story emerges; Jim tries to get his questions answered.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E04 — Unintended Consequences
Maggie tries to convince Rebecca that she is fine; a protestor refuses to cooperate with Neal and Jerry after an interview with Will goes poorly; Jim gets heat from Mac.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E05 — News Night With Will McAvoy
Will is distracted during a telecast; Charlie gets a visit from a friend at the Office of Naval Intelligence; Sloan experiences humiliation and rage.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E06 — One Step Too Many
Mac and Charlie get a key witness; Will makes an appearance on a morning talk show; Jim gets unexpected company during his reunion with Hallie.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E07 — Red Team III
Rebecca pieces together the events leading to ACN's decision to air Jerry's special report on Operation Genoa; repercussions from the special report threaten to ruin "News Night."

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E08 — Election Night, Part I
Will becomes the director of morale as "News Night" goes forward with its election night coverage; Sloan is upset that her book was auctioned with a forged signature; the team considers holding off on a story that might influence a Senate race.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S02 E09 — Election Night, Part II
Will and Charlie await a decision from Reese; Sloan learns the identity of the winning bidder for her book; Neal seeks Hallie's help in giving Mac a parting gift; Jim tries to make peace with Lisa; Will has a revelation.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S03 E01 — Boston
In the wake of the Genoa debacle, the team decides to use caution in reporting a major breaking story; Neal is contacted by an anonymous source in possession of stolen government documents; Sloan looks to solve a takeover puzzle.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S03 E02 — Run
Will tries to protect Neal from the fallout over the leak; Sloan fears Don may be cashing in on insider information; Maggie considers eavesdropping; Hallie suffers consequences of a late-night tweet.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S03 E03 — Main Justice
Leona and Reece try to raise cash to save the network; Will gets a surprise at the White House Correspondents' Dinner; Maggie's EPA scoop makes it to "News Night"; Sloan and Don try to keep their relationship a secret.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S03 E04 — Contempt
Will stands firm in his refusal to reveal the source of the stolen documents; Sloan and Mac scramble to find a buyer for the network; Jim and Hallie's relationship is tested.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S03 E05 — Oh Shenandoah
Will is incarcerated for contempt; Charlie orders Don to track down principals in a sexual abuse case at an elite college; Sloan voices her objection to a new digital site; Jim and Maggie try to get seats on a Cuba-bound plane.

title: The Newsroom
description:
S03 E06 — What Kind of Day Has It Been
A colleague's death leads Will and Mac to think about the milestones that transformed the newsroom; Maggie lands an interview in Washington; Neal's digital site is shut down for repairs; Leona offers advice to Pruit.

title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
description: A deep dive into the storied and complex legacy of "Ms." magazine through the lens of some of its covers.

title: Lanterns

Hal and John press forward with their investigation into Manhunter's true identity. The Guardians grow restless in their efforts to replace Hal.

title: Pearl
description: Trapped on an isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the watch of her mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

title: The Strangers
description: Three masked assailants terrorize a young couple (Liv Tyler, Scott Speedman) in a romantic getaway to a remote cottage.

title: The Strangers: Chapter 1
description: After their car breaks down in an eerie small town, a young couple is forced to spend the night in a remote cabin. Panic ensues as they are terrorized by three masked strangers who strike with no mercy and seemingly no motive.

title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
description: After learning that their victim, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya finds herself in a fight for survival against psychopaths who'll kill anyone who stands in their way.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E01 — The Pilot
Teddy, Phil, Lilly, and Ronnie vow to figure out why so many kids have gone missing in Derry; Major Leroy Hanlon arrives at Derry Air Force Base, where he navigates a chilly reception from some of his fellow airmen.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E02 — The Thing in the Dark
Charlotte and Will navigate their new life at the town of Derry; Ronnie worries about her father's fate.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E03 — Now You See It
General Shaw pushes ahead with his mission, ordering Leroy and Pauly to escort Dick Hallorann on an aerial search for a new dig site; Rose attends a tribal meeting; Ronnie, Lilly, Will, and Rich attempt to get visual proof by conjuring an Orixá.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E04 — The Great Swirling Apparatus of Our Planet's Function
Children encounter frightening situations while Charlotte supports Hank and General Shaw increases pressure.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E05 — 29 Neibolt Street
After learning the truth about General Shaw's operation, Leroy decides to move his family to the base for safety; while the tribal Keepers strategize how to contain increased aggression in town, the military descends on Neibolt Street.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E06 — In the Name of the Father
Plagued by dark visions, Dick gets a surprise at the Black Spot; all the kids face their own challenges.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E07 — The Black Spot
A vigilante attack on the Black Spot unleashes long dormant forces; in the aftermath, Dick helps uncover another crucial artifact.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E08 — Winter Fire
A dense fog descends upon Derry as General Shaw presses forward with his mission; consequently, the Hanlons join forces with Rose, Dick and the children in a desperate attempt to protect their town.

S01 E01 — Welcome to Topeka
When a double murder conviction is overturned with the help of two citizen sleuths, investigative journalist Joe Sexton digs into the case.

title: Us
description: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

title: The Hole in the Ground
description: One night, Sarah's young son disappears into the woods behind their rural home. When he returns, he looks the same, but his behavior grows increasingly disturbing. Sarah begins to believe that the boy who returned may not be her son at all.

Hal and John press forward with their investigation into Manhunter's true identity. The Guardians grow restless in their efforts to replace Hal.

title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives
description:
S01 E01 — A Star Is Born
Clover must leave her family behind to compete in an algorithm-based singing competition; pressure from the judges leads Clover to doubt herself, but her family's words give her the strength to perform.

title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives
description:
S01 E03 — Jack and the Beanstalk
When Jack, a neurodivergent young man and a top employee, is denied a promotion at The Beanstalk Grocery, he must find the courage to push for what's right.

title: The Snakes
description: A woman's violent fantasies spiral out of control when she joins a neighborhood watch group.

title: Materialists
description: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
description: Author A.A. Milne finds inspiration from his son to write Winnie-the-Pooh and The House at Pooh Corner in the 1920s. His family soon becomes swept up in the success of the books, while the tales bring hope and comfort to postwar England.

title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
description: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home, and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
description: The dwarves, along with Bilbo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, continue their quest to reclaim Erebor, their homeland, from Smaug. Bilbo Baggins is in possession of a mysterious and magical ring.

title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
description: Bilbo and company are forced to engage in a war against an array of combatants and keep the Lonely Mountain from falling into the hands of a rising darkness.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A chosen hobbit (Elijah Wood) and his loyal friends join a wizard (Ian McKellen), humans, a dwarf and an elf on a quest to destroy a powerful ring and defeat an evil lord.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
description: Now divided, members of a fellowship take different paths to destroy the ring and defeat evil Sauron and his pawns.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
description: Frodo (Elijah Wood) and Sam march toward Mount Doom to destroy the ring, while Gandalf (Ian McKellen) and warriors prepare for a final confrontation with Sauron and his allies.

title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
description: A couple is shocked when their missing daughter is returned to them after disappearing eight years earlier. However, what should be a joyful family reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying.

title: The Age of Adaline
description: A woman who has miraculously remained young for nearly 80 years meets a charismatic philanthropist who reawakens her passion for life and romance.

title: The Color Purple
description: Torn apart from her sister and her children, Celie faces many hardships, including an abusive husband. With support from a singer and her stepdaughter, she ultimately finds extraordinary strength in the unbreakable bonds of a new kind of sisterhood.

title: Amy
description: Archival footage and personal testimonials present an intimate portrait of the life and career of British singer/songwriter Amy Winehouse.

When a double murder conviction is overturned with the help of two citizen sleuths, investigative journalist Joe Sexton digs into the case.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E05
Following new recruit John Stewart and "Lantern" legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

title: Babygirl
description: A high-powered CEO puts her career and family on the line when she begins a torrid affair with her much younger intern.
